_comment: VST parameter table for the Crate Digger plugin. ORDER IS THE VST INDEX: append only, never reorder (projects and the skin bind to indices). types: stepper (index into a dynamic list; value text = item), trigger (fires on >0.5, springs back), float, readout (display-only text), slot (result row: value text = title, tap = play, value 1 = playing), grid (one key of the search text: 'chars' lists the character each cell types, 'options' the label each cell draws -- one label more than chars, the last being a dead cell), flag (a hidden skin-only 0/1, named by popup_of).
_comment_search: The SEARCH tab's parameters. The MPC plugin host has no text entry (mpc-vst-plugins docs/NOTES.md), so the search text is typed one key at a time from query_key's key grid; vst/query_edit.h holds the buffer, the skin's popup field shows whatever query_text says, and the picked text rides to Discogs inside the same filter JSON the facet steppers use (src/bin/yt_dlp_daemon.py sends it as Discogs' q=).
_comment_grid_spacer: query_key's LAST option is a dead cell: the wrapper always reports that index as the grid's current value, and MPC sends nothing for the cell it thinks is already selected -- so no real key can ever be the 'already selected' one and typing the same letter twice always works. It is also why 'options' has exactly one entry more than 'chars' (gen_params.py asserts that).
_comment_open: query_key__open is the hidden flag a skin popup needs (the shape mpc-vst-plugins' shadow_skin.popup_params emits). Skin-only state: never sent to the engine, never saved in a preset. Picking a key clears it, which closes the drawn grid.
_comment_search_rest: query_artist re-searches using the artist of the last result row tapped (no typing). query_filters displays the facet steppers the next search will send, so a text search is never quietly narrowed by a filter left over from browsing.
